content_sections.heading: IIT Patna JRF Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIT Patna recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the IIT Patna recruitment is Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the JRF post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have an M. Tech/PhD in electrical engineering with knowledge of electric motor and controller design.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF position is 45 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37000 Per Month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through a Walk-in Interview process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the date of the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 25 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at Indian Institute of Technology Patna, Bihar.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.
